questions.title: Who will be the first major Ukrainian political figure to publicly call for wartime elections following Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion?
questions.background: Ukrainian law bars elections during wartime. The presidential election has been postponed under continuing martial law, although Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s presidential term ended in May 2024.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Qualifying Event : Identify the person credited in reliable reporting with the first public call by a major Ukrainian political figure since Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion to resume national elections while the war continues. A call solely for elections after the war ends does not qualify. Resolution Timing : Resolve when the qualifying statement becomes public, provided this occurs by August 31, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The politician’s full name.

questions.title: Which Ukrainian suspect, if any, will be arrested in August 2026 in connection with Germany's investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline bombings?
questions.background: Germany is investigating the September 2022 explosions that damaged the Nord Stream gas pipelines. A former Ukrainian army officer was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany that November.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Confirmation from German federal prosecutors or the authorities carrying out the arrest, as reported by reliable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian suspect physically arrested during August 2026 pursuant to a German warrant concerning the September 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. The issuance of a warrant without an actual arrest does not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The suspect's full name. If no qualifying arrest occurs during August 2026, answer “None”.

questions.title: Who will be exercising the duties of governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state on August 21, 2026?
questions.background: Sinaloa's governor took a leave of absence on May 1 after being indicted by U.S. prosecutors on drug-trafficking charges. The question concerns who actually performs the governor's duties, rather than who retains the title while on leave.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Mexican government statements and contemporaneous news reporting identifying the person exercising Sinaloa's gubernatorial duties on August 21, 2026. Resolution Rule : If the elected governor remains on leave, resolve to the acting governor. If the elected governor has resumed duties by that date, resolve to the elected governor. Accepted Answer Format : The officeholder's full name.

questions.title: Which country's public broadcaster will announce a boycott of Eurovision 2027 in August 2026 over concerns about the contest's political neutrality?
questions.background: Countries participate in the Eurovision Song Contest through national broadcasters, which decide whether to enter the competition.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official statement from the withdrawing broadcaster, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country whose public broadcaster announces during August 2026 that it will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, citing concerns about the contest's political neutrality. Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.

questions.title: Who will be Norway's reigning monarch on August 29, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Norwegian Royal House announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations. Resolution Rule : Identify the person legally holding Norway's crown at the beginning of August 29, 2026, local time. Accession determines the answer, regardless of whether an oath-taking ceremony or coronation has occurred. Accepted Answer Format : The sovereign's regnal name, including the ordinal.

questions.title: Which leader will the Kremlin announce as Vladimir Putin’s counterpart for bilateral talks on the Ukraine war at the 2026 SCO summit?
questions.background: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) holds an annual leaders’ summit, which also provides opportunities for bilateral diplomatic meetings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Kremlin statements or reliable news reporting quoting a Kremlin official, published by August 31, 2026. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the leader publicly identified as scheduled to meet Vladimir Putin bilaterally on the sidelines of the 2026 SCO summit to discuss the Ukraine war. The announced meeting schedule determines the answer; the meeting need not have taken place. Accepted Answer Format : The leader’s full name.

questions.title: Which Ukrainian city away from the eastern and southern front lines will experience repeated Russian strikes on fuel stations by September 11, 2026?
questions.background: Russian attacks have repeatedly hit fuel stations near Ukraine’s eastern and southern battle lines. The spread of this targeting pattern to cities farther from the fighting would broaden its impact on civilians.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Ukrainian municipal statements and reliable contemporaneous reporting citing local authorities. Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian city outside the eastern and southern frontline areas where Russian attacks are confirmed to have directly struck fuel stations on at least two separate days between September 1 and September 11, 2026. Reports of isolated attacks or incidental damage to nearby stations do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the city.

questions.title: Which country will Washington propose as a possible venue for renewed trilateral Russia–Ukraine ceasefire talks by September 25, 2026?
questions.background: The United States has been involved in efforts to broker an end to the Russia–Ukraine war.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country publicly identified by Ukraine's president as Washington's proposed location for renewed talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine, using the proposal current as of September 25, 2026. A suggested location is sufficient; the talks need not have taken place. Resolution Date : 2026-09-25 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: Which country will be the first in 2026 to publicly acknowledge deploying purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit?
questions.background: Military satellites provide communications, navigation and intelligence services. Deploying weapons in orbit could significantly change how countries protect or threaten these systems.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements by national governments or military officials, corroborated by reliable international news reporting. Qualifying Event : Resolve to the country whose government or military first publicly acknowledges during 2026 that it has already deployed purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit. Merely describing satellites with potential military applications, announcing future deployments, or confirming ground-based anti-satellite weapons does not qualify. Resolution Timing : Resolve on the date of the first qualifying public acknowledgment, provided it occurs by December 31, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name.

questions.title: Which country will be the focus of a joint appeal to leaders at the September 2026 UN General Assembly to safeguard humanitarian aid and support a nationally led peace process?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country targeted by the September 2026 appeal from international humanitarian, development and civil society organisations calling on UN General Assembly leaders to protect humanitarian aid delivery, maintain essential services and support a nationally led peace process. Use the organisations' public statement or contemporaneous Al Jazeera reporting. Resolution Date : 2026-09-23 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: Who will be the first person charged in the United Kingdom over alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide?
questions.background: British authorities have been investigating allegations involving Rwandan genocide suspects living in the United Kingdom.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official public charging announcement from the United Kingdom’s Crown Prosecution Service. Resolution : Identify the first individual formally charged in the United Kingdom in connection with alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide, provided the charges are announced by December 31, 2026. Arrests without charges, extradition proceedings, and charges brought outside the United Kingdom do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The person’s full name as given in the charging announcement.

questions.title: Which former minister from Viktor Orban's government, if any, will have parliamentary immunity lifted in September 2026 to permit an embezzlement investigation?
questions.background: The party that won Hungary's 2026 parliamentary election campaigned on tackling corruption. Parliamentary immunity can prevent prosecutors from pursuing criminal investigations against legislators unless Parliament lifts it.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Hungarian parliamentary records or contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations identifying former ministers whose immunity is lifted. Qualifying Event : Hungary's Parliament must vote during September 2026 to remove a former Orban-government minister's immunity specifically to allow prosecutors to pursue an embezzlement investigation. Allegations alone, without the parliamentary vote, do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : Provide the former minister's full name. If no former minister qualifies during September 2026, resolve as no qualifying minister.

questions.title: Which country will become the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords by September 27, 2026?
questions.background: The Artemis Accords establish principles for international cooperation in civil space exploration.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements from NASA or the U.S. Department of State, or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera. Resolution : Resolve to the country that becomes the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords on or before September 27, 2026. A completed signing is required; an expression of interest or an intention to sign does not qualify. A signing after that deadline does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.
